events.title: NZ parliamentary elections
events.actual: Preliminary count complete (99.4% of voting places): Labour won the party vote 29.36% (710,330 votes) vs National 29.21% (706,680) — a 3,650-vote margin; seats National 42, Labour 36, ACT 13, NZ First 12, Greens 16, Te Pāti Māori 5, Opportunity 7; National+ACT+NZ First hold 67 of 131 seats (one above the 66 needed); Labour bloc 57, +Opportunity 64. ~399,365 special votes remain; official result Nov 27 (Electoral Commission preliminary results via Reuters/BBC)
events.why: New Zealand voted Sat Nov 7 — fiscal and RBNZ-mandate backdrop into the Dec 9 decision; preliminary count complete, Labour won the party vote but the incumbent bloc holds 67 seats; official result Nov 27 after special votes.
events.outcome: No government yet — the incumbent coalition holds a one-seat preliminary majority, but special votes could flip it; coalition talks wait for the Nov 27 official result. NZD impact minimal so far (Friday's -1.20% was the NFP dollar, not the vote).

events.title: BoJ Summary of Opinions (Oct 29-30 meeting)
events.actual: Released 8:50 JST Nov 10: Oct 29-30 meeting opinions — several members said the Bank should decide the next hike 'without becoming overly cautious' and 'step up the pace' toward the neutral rate, seen 'considerably above 1%'; others warned the policy rate has entered the estimated neutral range and a further hike could weigh on the economy; core CPI (ex-fresh-food) seen above 3% into year-end
events.why: The October meeting's minutes-in-miniature — the board held 8-1 at 1.25% with Takata dissenting for 1.50%; any hawkish tilt in the opinions firms the ~80% December hike pricing Ueda declined to push back on Friday.
events.outcome: Split board, December hike stays live: hawks push faster normalization toward neutral, doves warn the rate is already in neutral territory; no new December steer beyond the ~80% pricing going in. USD/JPY flat ~157.98 after release.
